name: Tm Image Carousel
pitch: Browse data-backed pictures, scan a gallery, and keep each view in step with Qlik selections.
question: Which products, places or assets match the current selections?
questions: Which products or assets match the current selections?
What does each picture show before I open a record?
Which pictures need a closer look or a follow-up link?
useWhen: Present data-backed pictures on a Qlik sheet
audience: Qlik analysts and app builders presenting picture-based data to others.
features: Browse one to four pictures with arrows or previews
Scan and select a scrolling gallery
Add captions, descriptions, values and links
Zoom in or open a picture large
Keep the view in step with Qlik selections

featureStrips.heading: Inspect fine picture detail
featureStrips.text: Viewers can inspect a picture at up to four times its size, then return to the full view.
featureStrips.alt: Zoom controls enlarge a night-time camping stove while carousel arrows remain available.

featureStrips.heading: Keep overlaid captions readable
featureStrips.text: A blurred copy fills empty space behind a caption placed over the picture.
featureStrips.alt: A mountain picture with its caption over the image and a soft blurred background.

featureStrips.heading: Keep navigation compact in small charts
featureStrips.text: As space shrinks, the preview strip gives way to dots or a counter, keeping pictures in focus.
featureStrips.alt: Three chart sizes compare a preview strip, dots and a position counter.

featureStrips.heading: Catch missing click destinations
featureStrips.text: Edit mode flags a sheet action with no destination before viewers try the click.
featureStrips.alt: An edit-mode hint asks the author to set a destination sheet for the click action.

featureStrips.heading: Open a picture large
featureStrips.text: Open large fills the page with a picture and adds controls to move and zoom.
featureStrips.alt: Open large shows a fjord kayak with Previous, Next, Close and zoom controls.

featureStrips.heading: Follow the reading direction
featureStrips.text: Right-to-left apps mirror arrows, keys, swipes, slides and the gallery grid.
featureStrips.alt: A camping stove in the mirrored carousel, with Previous on the right and Next on the left.
